summary: V3.5 review — Cost-engine corrections (BESM ≥1/Level clamp, defects-on-items, defect-refund SUBTRACTION) + per-Attribute Enh/Lim whitelist + campaign benchmarks (genre/time_period/size_scale/damage_rating_baseline). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_v35.py with 13 focused tests; ALL 13 PASS. Whitelist via /api/besm/reference verified for all 6 spot-checks: Tough(no enh, open=false), Item(open kit 5 enh + 23 lim, open=false), Wealth(no enh), Mind Control(all 5 enh), Heightened Senses(only Range). Cost engine: Tunnelling lvl=2 cpl=2 with 2 limiters → attr_cost=2 (clamp floors per_level at 1); extreme over-limit cpl=1 with 5 limiters → still 1*level. Item lvl=6 cpl=1 + Achilles Heel rank=1 ppr=2 → 4 net (subtotal 6 - refund 2). Item lvl=1 cpl=1 + defect refund 5 → floors at 0. Stats 12 + Marked rank=1 ppr=1 → total_spent=11 (CONFIRMED defect refunds SUBTRACTED, not added). Campaign benchmarks: PUT/GET round-trip works for genre='Cosmic Horror', time_period='Modern', size_scale='Personal', damage_rating_baseline=7; character created in that campaign returns derived.damage_rating_baseline=7 and damage_multiplier=7 (no Massive Damage) / 17 (with Massive Damage lvl=2). Frontend Playwright smoke: /app/campaigns/{cid} → Primer tab — primer-benchmarks card present with all 5 testids (primer-genre, primer-period, primer-size, primer-dr, primer-save-btn); typed High Fantasy / Medieval / DR=7, saved, reloaded → values persist. Character Builder /app/campaigns/{cid}/characters/new — campaign-briefing card present with bench-genre='High Fantasy', bench-period='Medieval', bench-dr='DR baseline · 7'; bench-size correctly hidden when default 'Personal' (per code line 202: only renders when size_scale !== 'Personal'). The whitelist-disabled Enh chips and Defects-on-Item UI flow could not be exercised end-to-end because the Picker's Add button uses dynamic testid `add-${testIdPrefix}-btn` and the inline attribute selector is gated behind clicking that picker — the source confirms attr-item-defects-{idx}, attr-add-defect-{idx}, attr-defect-{idx}-{j} all exist (CharacterBuilder.jsx lines 765, 770, 782) but the script could not stably select 'Tough' inside the picker dropdown within budget. Static code review confirms whitelist enforcement: AttributeRow Customise panel reads campaign.allowed_enhancements/limiters and applies disabled+opacity-30+cursor-not-allowed classes per the whitelist returned by /api/besm/reference. No console errors in any tested surface. NOTE: in-builder live derived DM display showed 5 instead of 7 for an unsaved character even though backend returns 7 — minor frontend-local calc may not consume campaign.damage_rating_baseline (cosmetic only; persisted character is correct).

ui_bugs.issue: Live (unsaved) derived DM in the builder shows 5 instead of campaign.damage_rating_baseline (7). Backend returns correct 7 on save/GET. Frontend useMemo at ~lines 76-100 likely missing campaign.damage_rating_baseline override.

action_items: (MEDIUM) CharacterBuilder live-derived DM should mirror calc_derived's V3.5 baseline override: const dmBase = campaign?.damage_rating_baseline > 0 ? campaign.damage_rating_baseline : 5; dm = dmBase + (massiveDamage*5). Currently appears to use static 5.

(LOW) Add a stable data-testid='add-attribute-btn' to the Picker trigger when used for the Attributes section (currently dynamic add-${prefix}-btn) so future Playwright tests can reliably exercise the whitelist + Defects-on-Item flow without prefix guessing.
(LOW) Optional: add data-testid on each Enhancement/Limiter chip in the Customise panel (e.g. attr-${idx}-enh-${name}) so the disabled state can be asserted in Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py attribute_cost() correctly enforces max(1, base+mods) per-level clamp AND max(0, subtotal - nested_refund) — single source of truth used by both calc_spent_points and any caller. Good.
calc_spent_points now SUBTRACTS defect_points (line 998: total = stat_cost + attr_cost + skill_cost - defect_points) — matches BESM 4E p.154 spec; previous +defect_points behaviour double-counted.
calc_derived(ch, campaign) takes the campaign as 2nd arg and reads damage_rating_baseline only when it's a positive int — defensive against missing/None. Good.

Frontend bench-dr badge uses condition `damage_rating_baseline && damage_rating_baseline !== 5` — would HIDE the badge if a GM explicitly sets the baseline to 5 (the system default). Consider showing it always when explicitly set, or use a separate 'is_overridden' flag.
Frontend bench-size hides on 'Personal' — matches spec but means future renames of the default scale need both backend and frontend kept in sync. Centralise the default constant.
Whitelist data ATTRIBUTE_MOD_WHITELIST in besm_data.py is 30+ rows long — consider moving to JSON or a CSV-loader so non-engineers can edit; currently any tweak requires a code review.
/api/besm/reference now serialises 86 attrs × {allowed_enhancements, allowed_limiters, open_mods} on every call (carry-over comment from iter_8 about caching still applies — payload is fully static).
